page.layout: One page of text; ornamental headpiece and title at top, running text below; a small signature "A 2" at the foot; faint marginal fragments at the right edge (cropped, unreadable, not transcribed).

main_text.head: ETHICÆ Tractatus secundus, De Virtutibus vulgo dictis Particularibus. PROOEMIUM.
main_text.p: Virtus una est atque unica : cum igitur plures virtutes dicimus, non existimamus, quod ipsa virtus secundum se, & abstractim considerata, pluralitatem admittat, sed mentem demittimus in considerationem officiorum virtutis, quae sunt effecta, in quae virtus pro-pendet. Cum enim virtus sit propositum faciendi, quod jubet ratio (ut patet ex tractatu primo) hinc illa semper in factum aliquod propendet, quodque officium ejus dicitur. Officia haec admodum diversa sunt: saepe enim virtus propendet ad faciendum sumptum & ad hoc officium comparata, vocatur liberalitas; saepe ad parcendum, & tum dicitur

page.notes: The right-hand edge carries cropped fragments of a neighbouring page ("-uu", "-un"), not transcribed. The first word "Virtus" is set with a large woodcut initial V; it is read as "Virtus" and the initial is joined to the word. Catchword-like fragment "citur" at the line end is part of the paragraph.
